description: This source file defines the CategoryRepository class that handles fetching content items for various home categories from a network API, with fallback to sample data in case of errors. It includes methods to retrieve category data via an ApiService, map DTOs to content models, and provides context-specific documentation.

classes.name: CategoryRepository
classes.description: Repository class that handles fetching content items for various categories from the API, with local sample fallback.

methods.name: sampleItemsFor
methods.description: Generates a list of placeholder ContentItem objects for a given HomeCategory, used as a fallback when network requests fail.

methods.name: fetchCategory
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches content items for a specific HomeCategory from the network API, falling back to sample items on failure.
